== Technique admin page for Kindle (a technique of the major Gift Pyrecraft)
chosen Properties before: ["fiery"]
chosen Properties after unticking fiery in the widget: []
after Save: messages = ["The Technique “Kindle (Pyrecraft)” was changed successfully. You may edit it again below."]
chosen Properties on the reloaded page: []

== Power Builder page for the application "Light a pyre" (needs the property fiery)
techniques module text:
Techniques that do it
any gift
TECHNIQUE	GIFT · PATH	ITS PROPERTIES	GRANTS IGNITION	STRENGTH AT REFERENCE	EACH USE
Kindle	Pyrecraft · no path
 fiery
	base  per power   remove grant	11; 16 one level better	a cast: 4 anima, its own roll	edit all

Path is the path whose grant of the gift lists the technique. Untick fiery or remove the grant and the row moves to "one step away" on save.
checkbox 0: label="fiery" name=t1-properties checked=true
checkbox 1: label="remove grant" name=t1-remove_grant checked=false
